TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka ni-pamting, dou ni-pattæ'ï-kahan ti Jesus mattæ'i-limoulymmou ki sou k'atta, ka ni-k'ma ki Pahtatæutæuughan tyn,
S.TRANSL: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
耶穌說完了這一切的話，就對門徒說：

S.FORM: Kavana'noumi ka rorouha-appa ki wæ'i mou-vatoug-ah ki halida'æu-an, ka pæ'æ̈-tounnoun-eih ta Alak ki ka'æuloung tou pouna-væværæh-eih tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
「你們知道，過兩天是逾越節，人子將要被交給人，釘在十字架上。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-mæu'isâl ta Si-bavau ka Tama-p'hik, ta makou-sasoulat, ki mamoumou-appa ki taou, tou laf ki Dadyllo ka Sibavau, ka ti Kajafas ta nanang tyn.
S.TRANSL: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
那時，祭司長和民間的長老聚集在大祭司稱為該亞法的院裏。

S.FORM: Ka ni-kmi-ym ki sou, ka touroung-auh nein ki sivanavan'an ta ti Jesus, ka paka-patei-aul-appa ta teni.
S.TRANSL: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
大家商議要用詭計拿住耶穌，殺他，

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta neni: Assi tou ou-vavatoug-an, alei ka aousi-ah ki kavaroutti-vut'tan ki ta'u.
S.TRANSL: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
只是說：「當節的日子不可，恐怕民間生亂。」

S.FORM: Ka rou æ'ia-koua ta ti Jesus tou Bethanien tou tallagh ti Simon ka outaum-in-ato [ki Leproos:]
S.TRANSL: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
耶穌在伯大尼長大痲瘋的西門家裏，

S.FORM: Ni-ierroua tyni-æn ta jna ka mei-koua ki vahto ka poule ka roukoul, ka akou-rapol ka ouhang ki angal, ka ni-roudo tyn ta anna massi-halap ki voungo tyn tou irarong-en tyn tou avokkan.
S.TRANSL: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
有一個女人拿着一玉瓶極貴的香膏來，趁耶穌坐席的時候，澆在他的頭上。

S.FORM: Jrou ka kak'ytt'an ta anna ki Pahtatæutæuughan tyn, ouhang ni-maiddingit ta neni, koun, Kaumang ta atta-nynno-an k'atta?
S.TRANSL: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
門徒看見就很不喜悅，說：「何用這樣的枉費呢！

S.FORM: Ka ynna patou-ilpough papeila tou ouhang ki angal ta rahpoul katta, pap'hæ-an-ei ta than tyn ki ta'u ka malymmouk.
S.TRANSL: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
這香膏可以賣許多錢，賙濟窮人。」

S.FORM: Ra tou oumhgan ti Jesus [ta atta] ni-k'ma neini-æn, Ka'umang ka paka-himkou-'noumi ta jna k'atta? Ka mariang ta na ryngei tyn jau-an-da.
S.TRANSL: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
耶穌看出他們的意思，就說：「為甚麼難為這女人呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。

S.FORM: Ka myhkakoua akoumea'h-kamou ki ma-lymmouk æiakoua ymoumi-æn, râ aou-si-ah-kamou myhkakoua jau-an.
S.TRANSL: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
因為常有窮人和你們同在；只是你們不常有我。

S.FORM: Nda irou ka ni-roudo tyn ta rahpoul k'atta tou vouel-au, ni-pâmt-en tyn ta anna [tou sitan-in] ki ravak-ei jau-an.
S.TRANSL: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
她將這香膏澆在我身上是為我安葬做的。

S.FORM: Missing koun-nau-kamou, toumang ka pattasasou-eih ta Hagnau-k'atta ka mariang tou ymmid ki Næi, pasousou-eil-appa hynna ta mamang ka na ryngei-tyn tou hibava-lei-en tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
我實在告訴你們，普天之下，無論在甚麼地方傳這福音，也要述說這女人所行的，作個紀念。」

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna ni-d'marang ta saät ki sat kytti-æn 'æb ki rouha k'anna, ka ti Judas Iskarioth ta nanang tyn, ka ni-moukoua ki Si-bavau ka Tama-p'hik,
S.TRANSL: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
當下，十二門徒裏有一個稱為加略人猶大的，去見祭司長，

S.FORM: K'ma, Mang ta p'hei-anei-moumi jau-an, ka pæ'æ̈-tounnoun-eimau tyni-æn ymoumi-æn? Ka ni-si-kidi-en nein tyni-æn tourou kytti-æn ki malyttouk.
S.TRANSL: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
說： 「我把他交給你們，你們願意給我多少錢？」他們就給了他三十塊錢。

S.FORM: Ka na kidi k'anna ni-hauat-en tyn ta kidi ka mariang, ka mannono ka pæ'æ̈-tounnoun-an-eih tyn tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
從那時候，他就找機會要把耶穌交給他們。

S.FORM: Ka tou naunamou ki wæ'i ka assi ni-pei-apyng-it [ta paul] ni-iroua ta Pahtatæutæuughan ti Jesus, ka ni-koun nein teni-æn, Toumang ta kamoei-en-hou ka tanang-au-miæn ymhouan pa-kan ki joukko ki Hali-da'æu-en?
S.TRANSL: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
除酵節的第一天，門徒來問耶穌說：「你吃逾越節的筵席，要我們在哪裏給你預備？」

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta teni, Oukoua-au tou æuma k'anna ti anno-an, ka bana tyni-æn, Na sou ki Mahtatæutæuuh, tou touk ta kidi-au, k-koua-ah-koh kman ymhou-an [ki joukko] ki Hali-daæu-en lam ki Pahtatæutæuughen-au.
S.TRANSL: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
耶穌說：「你們進城去，到某人那裏，對他說：『夫子說：我的時候快到了，我與門徒要在你家裏守逾越節。』」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mei-amut ta Pahtatæutæuugh-an, mama ki na si-atæutæuugh ti Jesus neini-æn, ka ni-patau-tan nein [ta joukko] ki Hali-daæu-en.
S.TRANSL: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
門徒遵着耶穌所吩咐的就去預備了逾越節的筵席。

S.FORM: Jrou ka mad-oung-ato ni-k-lam meirrong ki sat kytti-æn 'æb ki rouha.
S.TRANSL: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
到了晚上，耶穌和十二個門徒坐席。

S.FORM: Jrou ka kannin nein, anna ta ni k'ma ta teni, Missing koun-nau-kamou, ka saät ymoumi-æn ta si-vanavana-ah jau-an.
S.TRANSL: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
正吃的時候，耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。」

S.FORM: Ka rou ou-hang ta neni mivavoulas, ni-mattæ'i-naunamou ta meihbouavou-al neini-æn mattæ'i-kmahynna tyni-æn, Ti jau kaua Meirang?
S.TRANSL: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
他們就甚憂愁，一個一個地問他說：「主，是我嗎？」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta teni, k'ma, Teni ka smilam jau-an dmauk ki rima tyn tou tangia, teni ta si-vanavana-ah jau-an.
S.TRANSL: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
耶穌回答說：「同我蘸手在盤子裏的，就是他要賣我。

S.FORM: Ouma-ato ka d'marang ta Alak ki ka'æuloung mama ki nisoulat-en-ato tyni-æn, râ ænnæih ki ta'u k'anna ka sivanavana-ah ki Alak ki ka'æuloung, ynna mariang tyni-æn, rou assi ni-pei-alak-kin ta ka'æuloung k'anna.
S.TRANSL: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
人子必要去世，正如經上指着他所寫的；但賣人子的人有禍了！那人不生在世上倒好。」

S.FORM: ka ti Judas ka si-vanavana tyni-æn ta ni-mattæ'i-v'lli, k'ma, Ti jau kaua Rabbi? Ni-k'ma ta teni tyni-æn, Pattæ'i-rouk-en-ato'mhou.
S.TRANSL: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
賣耶穌的猶大問他說：「拉比，是我嗎？」耶穌說：「你說的是。」

S.FORM: Jrou ka mei-kakan ta neni, ni-mmeugh ta ti Jesus ki paoul, ka rou ni-makou-v'lli makou Alilid, ni-pihpi tyn, ka ni-p'hæn tyn ki Pahtatæutæuug-han tyn ta atta, ka ni-k'ma, Arau, kan-nau, atta ta voual-au.
S.TRANSL: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝福，就擘開，遞給門徒，說：「你們拿着吃，這是我的身體」；

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-æugh tyn ta hæuugh ka äyht-en, ka rou ni-pako-vlli-tyn mako-Alilid, ni-p'hen tyn neini-æn ta atta, k'ma, Houh-tmouk-au moumi tou [hæuugh ki] atta.
S.TRANSL: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
又拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們，說：「你們都喝這個；

S.FORM: Ka atta ta 'æmagh-au, [ta æmagh] ki Si-kavag-hen ka va'æu, ka tiri-auh alei ki mabatoung tou atta-nynno-an ki varau.
S.TRANSL: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
因為這是我立約的血，為多人流出來，使罪得赦。

S.FORM: Ka pasousou-en-au-kamou, ka assimau yht-auh na kidi hnyn ki na voua k'atta ki nḡara ki karæumætæh, tou kidi-appa ki wæ'i k'anna, rou hou-baæu-au-mau myt ta atta hmou-lam ymoumi-æn tou pei-sasou-an ki raraman-au.
S.TRANSL: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
但我告訴你們，從今以後，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在我父的國裏同你們喝新的那日子。」

S.FORM: Jrou ka taka-kahan nein ta taka-loulough-an, ni-t'pæpænæh ta neni moukoua tou voukkyn ka makka-vavoua ki akou-imagh.
S.TRANSL: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
他們唱了詩，就出來往橄欖山去。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Paka-ymdau-kamou paka-varau ki euvan k'atta: Alei ka ni-sasoulat-in, Æp'd-aumau ta Souajam, ka papaiävoak-auh ta joukko ki jouagh.
S.TRANSL: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
那時，耶穌對他們說：「今夜，你們為我的緣故都要跌倒。因為經上記着說： 我要擊打牧人， 羊就分散了。

S.FORM: Jrou ka hkaha-al-ato-koh æhpit, 't ourourou-ah-koh ymoumi-æn mou-koua tou Galileen.
S.TRANSL: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
但我復活以後，要在你們以先往加利利去。」

S.FORM: Râ ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Petrus k'ma tyni-æn, Meita rou paka-ymd-auh ta neni paka-varau alei ymhou-an, myh-kakoua koh assi pakavarau-auh ta ti jau.
S.TRANSL: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
彼得說：「眾人雖然為你的緣故跌倒，我卻永不跌倒。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Missing kounnau kow, ka tou euvan k'atta dou assi-appa mouni ta taoukka, ka t' touroul-ei-mhou rmau jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
耶穌說：「我實在告訴你，今夜雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Petrus tyni-æn, Meita-rou pis-lalam-appa-mau-kow mapatei, assi-koh rmau-ah ymhou-an. Ka komm'appa-hynna ki sou ta ymmid ki Pahtatæutæuughan.
S.TRANSL: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
彼得說：「我就是必須和你同死，也總不能不認你。」眾門徒都是這樣說。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-toulam neini-æn ta ti Jesus mou-koua tou jtoukakoua-an ka pananang-en Gethsemane, ka ni-k'ma ki Pahtatæutæuughan, Mierrong-â hia tou kidi ki ou-koua-eimau hynna mako-Alilid.
S.TRANSL: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
耶穌同門徒來到一個地方，名叫客西馬尼，就對他們說：「你們坐在這裏，等我到那邊去禱告。」

S.FORM: Jrou ka patou-para tyni-æn ti Petrus-an, ki rarouha-appa ka na alalak ti Zebedeus, ni-manaunamou mavoulas malouaf-appa mahymko ta teni.
S.TRANSL: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
於是帶着彼得和西庇太的兩個兒子同去，就憂愁起來，極其難過，

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta teni neini-æn, Mataraæugh mavoulas ta vatti-au tou kidi ki kapatei-an: jtou-koua hia mahamæuæ'-æ itoulam jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
便對他們說：「我心裏甚是憂傷，幾乎要死；你們在這裏等候，和我一同警醒。」

S.FORM: Jrou ka ni-oukakoukoua tyn, ni-mahgakup ki vlung tyn, ka ni-mako-Alilid, k'ma, Rama-au, heirou ka ilpoug-hin, pahaliæurægh-â jau-an ki hæuugh k'atta ka äyht-tan: Nda assi mama ki kamoei-en-au, râ mam'appa ki kamoei-en-hou.
S.TRANSL: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說：「我父啊，倘若可行，求你叫這杯離開我。然而，不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mou-koua ta teni ki Pahtatæutæuughan, ka ni-kmaba-lei neini-æn ka meirip, ka ni-k'ma ti Petrus-an, Maurou-kamou kaua mahamæuæ̈' toulam jau-an sasat ki tæ'lei?
S.TRANSL: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
來到門徒那裏，見他們睡着了，就對彼得說：「怎麼樣？你們不能同我警醒片時嗎？

S.FORM: Nda mahamæuæ'æ̂ mako-Alilid-â, ka assi-moumi ou-koua-eih tou r'pung-an: Massorol ta Joepan, râ assi mahsahkit ta vaat.
S.TRANSL: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
總要警醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。」

S.FORM: Mila tou kararouha dou ou-koun tyn, ni-mako-Alilid, k'ma, Rama-au, heirou assi mali-phough mali-æurægh iauan ta hæuuh k'atta ka äyht-ten, dou assi-mau hou-ouro-en myt, nda paamt-auto ta kamoei-en-hou.
S.TRANSL: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
第二次又去禱告說：「我父啊，這杯若不能離開我，必要我喝，就願你的意旨成全。」

S.FORM: Ka dou mou-koua ta teni, mila kmabalei neini-æn ka meirip: alei ka ouhang marisigh ta matta nein.
S.TRANSL: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
又來，見他們睡着了，因為他們的眼睛困倦。

S.FORM: Ka dou payhkakoua neini-æn, ni-ou-koun tyn mila, ka ni-mako-Alilid tou katatourou, mattæ'i-la teni ki sou-râ.
S.TRANSL: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
耶穌又離開他們去了。第三次禱告，說的話還是與先前一樣。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-mou-koua ta teni ki Pahtatæutæuughan tyn, k'ma neini-æn, Smasinipp-â smaki-likough ki mangahar pæ'i-hababa: K'ytt'ei matouk-ato ta kidi ki tæ'lei, ka pæ'æ̈-tounnoun-auh ta Alak ki ka'æuloung tou rima ki tama-kavarau.
S.TRANSL: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
於是來到門徒那裏，對他們說：「現在你們仍然睡覺安歇吧！時候到了，人子被賣在罪人手裏了。

S.FORM: Matti-mæuæ-æ̈ æhpit, oukoua-ei-mytta, k'ytt'ei, mou-touk-ato ta sim'hamha iau-an.
S.TRANSL: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
起來！我們走吧。看哪，賣我的人近了！」

S.FORM: Jrou ka masousou-appa ta teni, k'ytt'ei, Ni-iroua ta ti Judas ka saät ki sât kytti-æn 'æb ki rouha, ka toulam tyni-æn ta kalauan ka irang ka mei-koua ki tyrrau ki vavouvoukbouk, ka ni-padingien ki Tama-p'hik ka Sibavau, ki Mamoumou-appa ki ta'u.
S.TRANSL: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
說話之間，那十二個門徒裏的猶大來了，並有許多人帶着刀棒，從祭司長和民間的長老那裏與他同來。

S.FORM: Ka teni ka si-vanavana tyni-æn, ni-pou-kidi neini-æn, k'ma, Teni ka baigh-au-mau, teni ta ti anna, tmouroung-â tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
那賣耶穌的給了他們一個暗號，說：「我與誰親嘴，誰就是他。你們可以拿住他。」

S.FORM: Ka madys dou mou-koua ti Jesus-an, ni-koun tyn, Tabe Rabbi, ka ni-baigh tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
猶大隨即到耶穌跟前，說：「請拉比安」，就與他親嘴。

S.FORM: Râ ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Diou, oua-mang kow hia? Anna ta dou ni-moutouk ta neni, ni-pa-tkoua ki rima ti Jesus-an, ka ni-tmouroung-appa tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus and took him.
耶穌對他說：「朋友，你來要做的事，就做吧。」於是那些人上前，下手拿住耶穌。

S.FORM: Ka k'ytt'ei, sasat neini-æn ka tou-lam ti Jesus-an, dou ni-sikkigh ki rima, ni-lmouhgout ki tyrrau tyn, ka ni-rmad ki kouncia ki Dadyllo, tubbo ki tang-ira tyn.
S.TRANSL: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
有跟隨耶穌的一個人伸手拔出刀來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他一個耳朵。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Pou-likoug-au pou-karouloung ta tyrrau-ouho: alei ka na mamang ta mara ki tyrrau, sidad-au pakapatei ta neni ki tyrrau.
S.TRANSL: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
耶穌對他說：「收刀入鞘吧！凡動刀的，必死在刀下。

S.FORM: Pæh-dimdim-en-hou lava, ka assi-koh makou-lpough makou-Alilid hnyn ki Raraman-au, ka pa-tou-lam-ah ta teni jau-an masaoun madagh ki sat kytti-æn 'æb ki rouha ki Legioenen, ki Tama-Gnau.
S.TRANSL: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
你想，我不能求我父現在為我差遣十二營多天使來嗎？

S.FORM: Nda pavut-auh mama ki mang ta na sasoulat, [ka k'ma] ka pam't-an-eih komma-hynna ta mamang k'atta.
S.TRANSL: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
若是這樣，經上所說，事情必須如此的話怎麼應驗呢？」

S.FORM: Tou kidi ki tæ'lei katta ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus ki kalau-an, Ni t'pæpænæh-kamou mama ki moukouah ki Tama-lpogh, ki tyrrau ki vavouvouk-bouk, alei ki tou roung-au-moumi jau-an: wæ'ïi ni-mi-sâl-koh mierrong ymoumi-æn mahtatæutæuugh tou Kouva ki tatamd-den ki Alid, ka assi kamou ni-tmourong jau-an.
S.TRANSL: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
當時，耶穌對眾人說：「你們帶着刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜嗎？我天天坐在殿裏教訓人，你們並沒有拿我。

S.FORM: Râ ni-pamt-en ta-mamang k'atta alei ka pavut-aul-ato ta na sasoulat ki Tama Mattæ'i-tan-da. Tou kidi k'anna ni-pou-ymmid ilpout ta Pahtatæutæuug-han tyn, pa-itou-koua tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
但這一切的事成就了，為要應驗先知書上的話。」當下，門徒都離開他，逃走了。

S.FORM: Neni ka ni-tmouroung ti Jesus-an, ni-mad [tyni-æn] pa-ou-koua ti Kaifas-an ka Dadyllo ka Si-bavau, ni-mæu'i-sâl-hynna ta Makou-sasoulat ki Mamoumou-appa.
S.TRANSL: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
拿耶穌的人把他帶到大祭司該亞法那裏去；文士和長老已經在那裏聚會。

S.FORM: Ka ni-itou-dallia itou-æ̈ugh tyni-æn ta ti Petrus tou kidi-appa ki laf ki Dadyllo, ka rou mou-rbo-ato, ni-mi-lam mierrong ki Makoua, ka kakytta-auh tyn ta lymmou-lymmou.
S.TRANSL: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
彼得遠遠地跟着耶穌，直到大祭司的院子，進到裏面，就和差役同坐，要看這事到底怎樣。

S.FORM: Râ Tama-P'hik ka Si-bavau Mamoumou, ki na-pæu'i-sasâl-appa ta ni-kmi'ym ki sou ka pattæ'i-hail-in si-haharang tou doumma ti Jesus-an, alei ki pakapatei-au nein tyni-æn, ka assi nein ni-paki-valei-en-dâ.
S.TRANSL: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
祭司長和全公會尋找假見證控告耶穌，要治死他。

S.FORM: Mou-kounna ka mabatoung ta Gmäil ka si-haharang ka ni-iroua-hynna, assi nein ni-pakivalei-en ki mamang.
S.TRANSL: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
雖有好些人來作假見證，總得不着實據。末後有兩個人前來，說：

S.FORM: Tou æ̈ugh-dâ ni-iroua ta rarouha ki Gmäil ka sihaharang, ka ni-k'ma, Teni katta ta ni-k'ma-k'ma, Kou-lpoughen-au kuhta ta Kouva ki tatamd-den ki Alid, ka mei-likough mei-ryngei ki anna tou toutourou ki wæ'ï.
S.TRANSL: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
「這個人曾說：『我能拆毀上帝的殿，三日內又建造起來。』」

S.FORM: Jrou ka 'æhpit ta Dadyllo, ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Assi-kow mattæ'i-v'lli ki mamang? Mang ta hail-len nein mattæ'i-doumma ymhou-an?
S.TRANSL: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
大祭司就站起來，對耶穌說：「你甚麼都不回答嗎？這些人作見證告你的是甚麼呢？」

S.FORM: Râ ti Jesus ta ni-meipat, ka mattæ'i-v'lli ta Dadyllo ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Paka-rihe-rihe-koh [matta sou] ymhou-an ki Alid ka mæuagh, ka banna-ah-kow ymiæn-æn, ma lava ka ti Christus kow, ka Alak ki Alid?
S.TRANSL: But Jesus held his peace, And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
耶穌卻不言語。大祭司對他說：「我指着永生上帝叫你起誓告訴我們，你是上帝的兒子基督不是？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Ni-mattæ'i-rouk kow. Ra k'ma-koh ymoumi-æn, na hnynnan k'atta k'ytt'ei-moumi ta Alak ki ka'æuloung tou ierrong-eih tyn tou ouwal ki kailhgen [ki Alid] rou ierroua-ah tou pourarei ki vullum.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
耶穌對他說：「你說的是。然而，我告訴你們，後來你們要看見人子坐在那權能者的右邊，駕着天上的雲降臨。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-ki it ta Dadyllo ki pammammien tyn, k'ma, Ni-barigh ta teni makou talum [ki Alid,] mangau-mi-an ta Mattæ'i-hail ka rouma? K'ytt'ei, ni-illingigh'noumi hnyn ta bavarugh tyn [ki Alid].
S.TRANSL: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
大祭司就撕開衣服，說：「他說了僭妄的話，我們何必再用見證人呢？這僭妄的話，現在你們都聽見了。

S.FORM: Pæh-mang ta rÿh-oumi? Râ neni ta ni-mattæ'i-v'lli k'ma, [Oohoh] mamsing ki pakapapatapatei.
S.TRANSL: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
你們的意見如何？」他們回答說：「他是該死的。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-padipaghan nein tou vlung tyn, ka ni-boukbouk en nein ki na kmud tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
他們就吐唾沫在他臉上，用拳頭打他，也有用手掌打他的，說：

S.FORM: Ka pani ki voual ta ni-tmaplagh tyni-æn tou timi, kma, Kæi-dmir-ou-kame kmæih-tan Christus, ti taplagh kow ti mang?
S.TRANSL: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
「基督啊！你是先知，告訴我們打你的是誰？」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mi-mala miraoung ta ti Petrus tou ta-tallaghin, ka saat ka kæuh-jna ka pæiroung-in ta ni-iroua tyni-æn, k'ma, Ni-makoilam-appa kow ta ymhou ti Jesus-an ka makka Galileä.
S.TRANSL: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
彼得在外面院子裏坐着，有一個使女前來，說：「你素來也是同那加利利人耶穌一夥的。」

S.FORM: Râ æmæh dmau ki taou ka ymmid, k'ma, Assi-mau oumhgan kamang ta sou ouho.
S.TRANSL: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
彼得在眾人面前卻不承認，說：「我不知道你說的是甚麼！」

S.FORM: Jrou ka mou-mala ta teni tou tangagh, ni-kmytta-appa ty-ni-æn ta pani [ka jna ka pæiroung-in] ka k'ma neini-æn ka æ'ia-koua hynna, Teni-appa ta na lam ti Jesus ka tæ'i-Nazareth.
S.TRANSL: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
既出去，到了門口，又有一個使女看見他，就對那裏的人說：「這個人也是同拿撒勒人耶穌一夥的。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-lala rmau ki sou ka na papakakariherihe, Assi-mau kalang-en ta ta'u.
S.TRANSL: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
彼得又不承認，並且起誓說：「我不認得那個人。」

S.FORM: Nda matouk ki kidi k'anna, ni-mou-koua ta mirouh-ko-hynna, ka ni-k'ma ti Petrus-an, Missing ymhou ta na lam-appa nein, nda pakalang-kow ki yng-au ouho.
S.TRANSL: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
過了不多的時候，旁邊站着的人前來，對彼得說：「你真是他們一黨的，你的口音把你露出來了。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-manaunamou mahko-avavagh tyni-æn pakariherihe-appa ki sou, Assi-mau kalang-en ta ta'u.
S.TRANSL: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
彼得就發咒起誓地說：「我不認得那個人。」立時，雞就叫了。

S.FORM: Ka ni-tma-touk mouni ta taoukka: ka ni-hmi-balei ta ti Petrus ki na sou ti Jesus ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Tou-ouro ki ouni-eih ki taoukka, sau-touroul-ah-kow rmau jau-an. Ka rou ni-samamala, ni-'ænum [ki rÿh tyn] ni-tmangitangi-ato.
S.TRANSL: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
彼得想起耶穌所說的話：「雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」他就出去痛哭。
